function.description: Execute one exact approved Lighter order cancellation. Direct calls are refused. After approval, the privileged runtime revalidates the unchanged active order, registered key, and nonce; atomically reserves the nonce; signs TxType 15 locally; persists transaction identity before one sendTx; and never retries ambiguity. Returns canceled only from exact provider inactive-order evidence, with executed, remaining, and average-fill amounts; otherwise returns a pending or ambiguous state.
function.name: lighter__order_cancel
